sources_and_limits.paper_explicit: Random 10k training examples; 3 epochs; global batch16; LLM LR2e-4; connector LR2e-5; connector rank128; LLM ranks16/32/64
sources_and_limits.author_code: alpha64, cosine, warmup0.03, weight_decay0, bf16, tf32, max_length2048, image padding, vision layer-2 and save_steps10000; public repository is the CVPR version, not a released TPAMI+ implementation
sources_and_limits.local_choices: Training/sampling seed42; deterministic image-marker placement; author-cited Mantis choose_txt formatting; connector alpha64. Random 10k sample follows paper §4.1; exact author sample IDs and TPAMI+ preprocessing are not claimed.
sources_and_limits.hardware_adjustments: Replicated DDP on two GPUs; batch4 and accumulation2 replaces author four-GPU batch4 accumulation1; non-reentrant gradient checkpointing; NCCL socket transport; recovery revision: disable gradient checkpointing to bypass observed checkpoint pack_hook/SystemError+SIGSEGV; save complete state every100 steps (author code10000), without changing optimizer steps or training objective
sources_and_limits.new_method: OrbitSparse, principal subspace protection, spectral connector sparsity, learned-scale Stiefel directions
